title: How Drinks Network Courses Work
description: A two-lesson walkthrough of how our courses run: watch, review, answer, then move on. Free, with a certificate at the end.

lessons.title: Watch, review, answer
lessons.review:
Every Drinks Network course is broken into short lessons, and every lesson has the same three steps.

1. Watch. Start with the lesson video, played right here on the page. Watch to the end to unlock the notes. (Where there's no video, the lesson is read aloud to you.)

2. Review. Read through the lesson notes. Take your time; you can come back to them at any point.

3. Answer. Finally, answer a few questions about what you've just learned. Get at least 80% right and the next lesson unlocks. If you miss the mark, have another look and try again.

Finish every lesson and you'll get a Drinks Network certificate with your name on it, ready to download or print. Your progress is saved in this browser, so you can stop and pick up where you left off.

questions.explain: Every lesson runs watch, then review, then answer.

options: At least 80% of the questions right
questions.explain: 80% or better unlocks the next lesson. You can retry as often as you like.

lessons.title: What you can learn with us
lessons.review:
Our courses cover the biggest-selling categories in liquor, so you can step up your game behind the bar, in the bottle shop or on the road as a rep.

Courses include Rice Spirits Explained, Rice Wine Explained, Whisky Explained, Bourbon Explained and Tequila Explained.

They're written for bartenders, retailers and curious drinkers, and they're a great foundation if you're joining RepShare as a Rep.

Every course is free, and each one ends with a Drinks Network certificate in your name.
